engines.row: Items on one horizontal row. w = (W - label_w - (n-1)*gap) / n. Chevrons overlap by point depth (0.25*h). Text under each item; max words per item shrinks with w (≈ w_in*12 words at 14pt). n above max -> wrap to 2 rows or group.
engines.column: Items stacked vertically. h = (H - (n-1)*gap) / n; label column 25-30% width. n above max -> two columns.
engines.ring: Items as arc segments of a ring. angle = 360/n, start at -90° (12 o'clock), clockwise; gap 2-4°; inner radius 0.55R. Labels inside if n<=6, else callouts outside at mid-angle (left half right-aligned, right half left-aligned).
engines.radial: Centre shape + n satellites at radius R, angle_i = -90° + i*360/n. R >= d/(2*sin(pi/n)) + gap so satellites never touch. Callouts follow the satellite's side.
engines.grid: rows x cols cells with equal gaps; header row/column optional. Choose cols = ceil(sqrt(n)) for n items unless orientation given.
engines.tree: Levels left->right (or top->down). Leaves evenly spaced; each parent centred on its children; elbow connectors.
engines.layers: n horizontal bands inside a triangle/funnel; band height = H/n; width at each band from the triangle edges; callouts aligned to band centres.
engines.nested: n concentric circles; radii r_i = R*(n-i)/n (or sqrt of values for area-true).
engines.venn: n circles (2-4) with centres on a regular polygon, overlap ~30% of diameter.
engines.converge: n inputs evenly spaced in a column -> lines/arrows converge to a single target at 70% width.
engines.branch: 1 source -> n branches; targets evenly spaced vertically; elbow or curved arrows.
engines.chart: Native PowerPoint chart from data; style per chart rules.
